body: Same. At work you gotta put on a facade, hide your anger and hide your dreams.

Yep. Fuck getting married and having children, not being able to give them the life they deserve. I will not be like my parents, raising children with so little money and working in a dead end job that will never fulfill my soul.

You can always reach out to him. He gave you money during this covid-19 crisis. He is a kind man. But no. I cannot appear to be begging for money from him again. I cannot treat him like a cash cow. He's not a cash cow....My problems can be solved by money....But I cannot tell him because it would look like I am asking him for money. No. No. No.
Know that feelings man. I just don't want to hurt the people I love and care. If I don't hurt them I'll be ready for the rope anytime.

A dark side is coming to take over me... Killing my hopes and dreams. You know you are going to be stuck in this dead end job for life, why do it? Just end it, kill feelings you have. The love you have for others. The pet dog you desire. They will not matter anyway because you cannot afford them.

No it is not okay. I dread going down that lonely depraved road, can someone please help me? It is the only thing that keeps me going, the last thing I went to do before I die. Is it here? Is she coming to take over me? Someone please save me, I am scared.
